# InkContentReader

## Intent

- Read untrusted HTML or GFM Markdown without executing source code.

## Prefer When

- A content string has an explicit html or markdown format.

## Avoid When

- Plain text must remain literal, or the application needs editing or remote media loading.

## Compose With

None
